target.tool: Customer-verified business interface; configuration-reference restrictions apply

key.note: Preserve source identifiers in an audit ledger; map regenerated internal IDs and target numbering. Never assume internal IDs survive migration.

structures.preprocessing: Unscoped candidate rows. Approve the full-key population at cutover; use customer-cohort-project.json. Resolve time intervals at cutover and map controlling areas, cost centers, profit centers and order numbers. Cost elements integrate with S/4HANA G/L accounts. COEP is source history, not a target Universal Journal posting template. Plan data, allocations, settlement and commitments require additional interface scope. Cycle headers and segments alone are insufficient. Export sender/receiver rules, set membership, tracing factors, accounts, plan/actual context, iterations and company restrictions through the verified native cycle configuration export. T811* table categories and keys vary; use the full-row helper where CDS is unavailable. Do not insert T811* or recreate cycles by posting journal entries; validate and execute a test cycle in the target.
